answer: Recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments compress each agent’s history into a succinct proof, while verifiable delay primitives impose sequential work that bounds identity cloning; the adversary’s forgery success decays exponentially in accumulated entropy, preserving an ember of advantage only under a collapsing grove of collusion. Information-theoretic unforgeability thus reduces Sybil spoofing to a negligible plume against Byzantine finality thresholds.
